title: Tiered Upgrade Templates
body:
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7871c580f9d8c046c0c16abba2a6bf5e5d91dd57.png)

Upgrade Templates for a custom modpack i'm forging!
**Recipeless** Templates from iron over diamond and emerald to obsidian.

I chose not to include recipes as i wanted to add custom recipes with crafttweaker! 
I'd recommend anyone using this mod to do so too! ;) 

The Templates can be used for all sorts of recipes.
I Mainly wanted to have upgradeable recipes for tools and e.g. iron furnaces or iron chests mods!

FEEL FREE to use it as however you want!
